notes: Replication values are author-derived primary project-table values, not independently converted. Original p.637 Table 2 visually verified; exact target pairwise N unprinted, so n is null. Original and replication tests are separately reported as printed. No individual narrative success verdict located; numeric success coding is not treated as narrative. Ozer and Benet-Martinez (2006) summarized the prospective associations between childhood personality and adulthood success, but the replication study can only test concurrent associations between adulthood personality and success. Supplied original locator points to a zero-order correlation (−.11); the replication authors’ table instead describes the original selected effect as a regression coefficient (−.24). Those distinct tests are not merged; replication standardized coefficient B is retained as printed.
